scene: At the carousel edge, three outgoing transit routes wait for passengers.
picture: A flat side view along the carnival boundary. On the far left sits a yellow bicycle rickshaw. Left of centre, the tall Latino man in his teal jacket and messenger bag stands beside the carousel railing. To his right, an iron book cart lift waits, beside an idling purple night bus on the far right.
